layout_sources: https://github.com/wimverstuyf/php-belgianbankstatement-parser/tree/master/tests/Samples (sample6_belfius.csv and sample7_belfius.csv: the search-criteria rows, "Laatste saldo;1.617,97 EUR", the ";" row, the 15-column header; CsvBelfiusParser.php)
https://github.com/renardeau/ofxstatement-be-belfius (reads ISO-8859-1 by default; skips the query header up to the line starting with ";" and then the column-name line)
notes: Belfius Direct Net / Belfius Mobile history export to CSV (Dutch): eleven "criterion;value" rows (only the start date filled here), "Laatste saldo;2.304,05 EUR" with a dot thousands mark and the currency after it, its date and time, a lone ";" row, then the header and the lines. Semicolon-separated, unquoted, dd/mm/yyyy, signed Bedrag with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, Devies EUR, oldest first as in the sample. ISO-8859-1 (a café name carries 0xC9). CRLF assumed (one sample has CRLF, another shows the doubled line breaks a CRLF file gets when re-saved). File name invented. Closing = "Laatste saldo": no end date is set, so the list runs up to the moment that balance was taken. No opening is printed.
